request_user:
Fact: design_rationale
What to find: How and why key design choices in training were made.
Card sections that often contain it: Training, Design

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: The card gives some rationale for training choices: SFT uses instruction-following, chain-of-thought and reasoning data to cultivate reasoning and thinking abilities; hyperparameters were tuned before scaling to all three model sizes; for the 30B model a second SFT phase up-sampled agentic data while retaining a smaller share of general replay data. RL uses GRPO across multiple environments, with verifiable rewards where available and a generative reward model for open-ended prompts; an RLHF phase tunes helpfulness, conversational quality, and safety.
quotes: The SFT stage draws on instruction-following, chain-of-thought, and reasoning data to cultivate the model's reasoning and thinking abilities.
Hyperparameters were tuned before training was scaled to all three model sizes.
For the 30B model, we conducted a second SFT phase, in which the agentic data was up-sampled while a smaller share of general replay data was retained.
Most environments provide verifiable rewards, while open-ended prompts are scored by a generative reward model.
After the reward-driven phases, a preference-alignment (RLHF) phase tunes helpfulness, conversational quality, and safety.
